Class SimpleSerialSocket

java.lang.Object
com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialSocket
com.sgware.serialsoc.SimpleSerialSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class SimpleSerialSocket extends SerialSocket
A SerialSocket that reads and writes messages as text and separates messages with new line characters. In other words, read() reads text from the socket until it encounters a new line and then returns that line. write(String) appends a new line to the end of every message.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

  • Constructor Details

    • SimpleSerialSocket

      protected SimpleSerialSocket(SerialServerSocket server, Socket socket, Reader reader, Writer writer)
      Creates a simple serial socket from a socket with given Reader (for reading text) and Writer for writing text. If the reader is not already a BufferedReader, it will be wrapped in one. If the writer is not already a BufferedWriter, it will be wrapped in one.
      Parameters:
      server - the serial server socket that created this socket and on whose main thread most events will run
      socket - the socket to which this serial socket will read and write
      reader - a reader for the socket's input stream
      writer - a writer for the socket's output stream

  • Method Details

    • read

      protected String read() throws IOException
      Description copied from class: SerialSocket
      Blocks until a new message is received by the socket's input stream. This method does not run on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run(). Once this method returns a message, it does not run again until SerialSocket.receive(String) has finished processing the message. If this method throws an exception, the socket closes.

      This method is meant to be called only by the socket's listener thread and should not be called from other contexts.

      Specified by:
      read in class SerialSocket
      Returns:
      a newly read message from the socket's input stream
      Throws:
      IOException

      Specified by:

    • disconnect

      protected void disconnect() throws IOException
      Description copied from class: SerialSocket
      Disconnects the socket from the network such that it can no longer send or receive new messages. This method should cause SerialSocket.read() to stop blocking if it is waiting. This method runs after SerialSocket.onClose() on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run(). It is possible the socket is already disconnected by the time this method runs if the socket was closed unexpectedly by the network.
      Specified by:
      disconnect in class SerialSocket
      Throws:
      IOException
